bio: Chef Nicolas Martin has taken over the reins of the restaurant at the Hotel VillaPona, a Grand Siècle coaching inn that has been completely renovated. The dining room channels the charm of its bygone days and peps it up with contemporary details. The chef hails from the region and has worked at Lameloise, Troisgros and Jérôme Brochot's restaurant. Here, he creates tasty dishes using fresh seasonal ingredients: smoked arctic char, artichoke and cauliflower; Bresse chicken with wild garlic and morels…...
